name: com.coffeebean.ui
description: UI module for the CoffeeBean framework: UGUI panel management (CUIManager/CUIPanel, 6 layers, panel stack, pluggable loader) + code generation (CBind marker, main/Designer two-file separation, auto-binding after compile). Loader pluggable: default Resources, CAssetPanelLoader for Addressables (via com.coffeebean.asset). Depends on com.coffeebean.tools + com.coffeebean.asset.

samples.description: UI 模块示例：打开/关闭面板、层级、栈式导航、传参、代码生成用法。
